title: fix(tests): old-use-apikeys deletes the file but leaves test:auth that sources it
description:
## .what
the bad-practice `cicd-common/bad-practices/old-use-apikeys` deletes `.agent/repo=.this/role=any/skills/use.apikeys.sh` and `use.apikeys.json`, and `tests-any/best-practice/package.json` rewrites `test` without its `eval $(ECHO=true npm run --silent test:auth)` prefix. but no check removes the `test:auth` entry itself, so a consumer is left with a command that sources a file the practice deleted. `package-json-order/best-practice/package.json.declapract.ts:58` still lists `test:auth` as a sort key.

upstream behavior `v2026_03_27.fix-test-creds` planned this removal ("update package.json to remove test:auth command and eval source pattern"); the eval half shipped, the command half did not reach consumers.

## .ask
- extend `old-use-apikeys` (or the tests-any package.json check) to drop an extant `test:auth` whose body sources `use.apikeys.sh`
- drop `test:auth` from the package-json-order key list

first seen in rhachet-roles-bhrain `.route/v2026_11_19.declapract.upgrade`, stone 3.3 (C1), classified a practice bug in stone 3.4.
